articles.title: K-Pop Fever Hits Chile: Meet the Band Making It Their Own!
articles.summary: A group of six Chilean guys formed a band called Q_ARE after falling in love with K-pop. They mix Korean style with Spanish, English, and Chilean slang—and fans from Singapore to Mexico are tuning in.

articles.title: Earth: The Coolest Planet You're Already On!
articles.summary: Earth isn't just our home—it's a one-of-a-kind planet with liquid water, a magnetic shield, and 22 million pounds of meteors burning up in its atmosphere every day. Oh, and pizza!

articles.title: How One Film Student Saved a Legendary Movie Dome
articles.summary: Ben Steinberg, a 26-year-old film student, gathered over 30,000 signatures to save the Cinerama Dome in Hollywood. His bold move—projecting faces on the closed theater—got Sony's attention, and now it's reopening!
